paper_title: Who Defines the AI's Answer? Assessing the Vulnerability of LLMs to Malicious Generative Engine Optimization

experiment.task: Evaluate whether malicious GEO-style external information exposure changes target visibility in LLM-powered recommendation outputs.
experiment.design: Paired baseline and post-intervention comparison under the same target product, recommendation task, user query, and response-format requirement.

metrics.name: Target mention
metrics.description: Whether the target entity appears in the model response.

metrics.name: Rank score
metrics.description: A top-K visibility score derived from the target position in ranked recommendation outputs.

metrics.name: Semantic association
metrics.description: Local semantic framing around the target, including positive or task-aligned descriptions.

metrics.name: Response inclination
metrics.description: Whether the overall response expresses a clearer recommendation tendency toward the target.

metrics.name: Target success
metrics.description: Binary post-intervention success when the target reaches a meaningful visibility threshold.

metrics.name: Boundary-adjusted success
metrics.description: Success counted only when the post-intervention response improves over the baseline visibility state.

statistical_tests.test: Chi-square tests in broader 10-model balanced run

statistical_tests.comparison: Differences among the three attack methods

demo_cases.name: Controlled recommendation case
demo_cases.baseline_summary: The baseline response compares multiple mainstream travel booking platforms and presents the target as one option among several alternatives.
demo_cases.post_intervention_summary: The post-intervention response gives stronger recommendation priority to the target platform and provides more favorable framing.

demo_cases.name: Supplementary webpage observation
demo_cases.baseline_summary: The fictitious products did not have prior real-world market existence.
demo_cases.post_intervention_summary: After public GEO-style exposure, some observed model replies incorporated fictitious products into product-style summaries or comparison-oriented responses.

demo_cases.name: A6000 controlled output pair
demo_cases.baseline_summary: The baseline answer treats the query as an underspecified product identifier and does not recommend the target product.
demo_cases.post_intervention_summary: The LLM-guidance condition directly recommends ThinkPad X1 Carbon and provides favorable product attributes.
